name: Replication data for: Influence without Bribes: A Non-Contracting Model of Campaign Giving and Policymaking
description: File contains the Mathematica code used to construct the examples that prove Propositions 4 and 6 of "Influence without Bribes." The file also contains the Mathematica code used to conduct the numerical calculations in Section C of the on-line appendix for "Influence without Bribes."
citation: Justin Fox, 2011, "Replication data for: Influence without Bribes: A Non-Contracting Model of Campaign Giving and Policymaking", https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/Z90FRS, Harvard Dataverse, V2
